targetQueries: printed paper packaging box artwork checklist
paper box printing and finishing options
buyerInputs: Box structure and product dimensions before discussing print layout
Artwork status, dieline availability and editable file format
Print coverage, logo placement and mandatory label area
Brand color reference, such as Pantone, CMYK or sample color target
Surface finish direction, including matte lamination, gloss lamination, foil stamping, embossing, debossing, spot UV or textured paper
Material and paperboard direction that may affect color and finish appearance
Insert, tray or inner support details that influence visible print areas
Target market and any document questions that require project-specific review

decisionMatrix.strongerBrief: Provides editable artwork, dieline status, logo placement and required label area

decisionMatrix.weakBrief: Asks for brand color without reference
decisionMatrix.strongerBrief: Provides Pantone, CMYK, physical sample or previous packaging reference
Separates lamination, foil, embossing, spot UV and paper texture preferences

decisionMatrix.weakBrief: Discusses printing before confirming box structure
decisionMatrix.strongerBrief: Confirms box type, dimensions, fold lines and visible surfaces before print review

decisionMatrix.weakBrief: Assumes the printer can decide all compliance wording
decisionMatrix.strongerBrief: Keeps labeling, certification and destination-market review document-based
